title: b7z9.35(b): C gateway — register tunnel_auth CoAP resource + app wiring
description: Child of b7z9.35. lichen/subsys/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.c (receive 327-367, decapsulate 416-457) compiles into the gateway subsys but has no coap_server resource registration and no app reference (grep lichen/apps/ = 0 hits).
